name: cavemio-message-edit
title: Message Edit
description: Edit and resend a message in place, then step between its previous versions.

cavemio.accessibility: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a line, and Escape cancels. Focus returns to the edit button. Copy status and version changes are announced politely. Reduced motion disables morphs.
cavemio.previewNote: Uses local demo data; no AI service or network requests.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Required. Called with the edited text; replace the message and regenerate from it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Optional. Disable editing, e.g. while an answer streams.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Optional. Explanation shown when editing is unavailable.

props.name: versions
props.type: { index: number; count: number; onIndexChange: (index: number) => void; }
props.description: Optional. Branches of this message, shown as "2 / 3".

props.name: children
props.description: Optional. How the sent message renders; defaults to the text.
